WITH daily_category_sales AS (
    SELECT
        pc.ProductCategoryName AS product_category,
        fs.DateKey AS sales_date,
        dd.CalendarDayOfWeekLabel AS day_name,
        sum(fs.SalesAmount) AS daily_sales
    FROM retail.FactSales AS fs
    INNER JOIN retail.DimDate AS dd
        ON fs.DateKey = dd.DateKey
    INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p
        ON fs.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
    INNER JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory AS ps
        ON toInt32(p.ProductSubcategoryKey) = ps.ProductSubcategoryKey
    INNER JOIN retail.DimProductCategory AS pc
        ON ps.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey
    GROUP BY
        pc.ProductCategoryName,
        fs.DateKey,
        dd.CalendarDayOfWeekLabel
)
SELECT
    product_category,
    avgIf(daily_sales, lower(day_name) IN ('saturday', 'sunday')) AS avg_weekend_day_sales,
    avgIf(daily_sales, lower(day_name) NOT IN ('saturday', 'sunday')) AS avg_weekday_sales,
    avgIf(daily_sales, lower(day_name) IN ('saturday', 'sunday'))
        - avgIf(daily_sales, lower(day_name) NOT IN ('saturday', 'sunday')) AS weekend_minus_weekday,
    if(
        avgIf(daily_sales, lower(day_name) NOT IN ('saturday', 'sunday')) = 0,
        NULL,
        (
            avgIf(daily_sales, lower(day_name) IN ('saturday', 'sunday'))
            / avgIf(daily_sales, lower(day_name) NOT IN ('saturday', 'sunday'))
            - 1
        ) * 100
    ) AS weekend_pct_bigger_than_weekday
FROM daily_category_sales
GROUP BY product_category
ORDER BY product_category;
